text:
Maya Chen: Heads-up from marketplace team: for the upcoming SI/hardware joint listing they want a compact evidence bundle. Required: a redacted SOC2 summary, pen-test exec summary, firmware checksums for any device images, and a signed attestation that redactions were performed. They asked for a single upload window. Timeline: intake window opens Thu morning, reviewer needs 72 hours to complete.
Ravi Desai: We can assemble SOC2 summary + pen summary. For firmware we should provide sha512 sums and the signed manifest (developer key). Legal will need to approve any pen-test redaction before we hand over raw details.
Nora Park: Operations note: we should create a dedicated partner prefix to avoid collisions: s3://marketplace-evidence/partners/si-789-hw/ . We'll require server-side encryption (SSE-KMS) and bucket access logging. Propose presigned links valid for 5 days (432000 seconds).
Diego Alvarez: Upload CLI snippet for partners (we'll hand this in the email):
```
# generate a presigned URL (server side)
aws s3 presign s3://marketplace-evidence/partners/si-789-hw/firmware-v1.bin --expires-in 432000

# partner side upload example (curl)
curl -X PUT "<PRESIGNED_URL>" --upload-file firmware-v1.bin -H "x-amz-server-side-encryption:aws:kms"
```
Sasha Ivanov: For manifests, require two files per firmware artifact: <artifact> and <artifact>.sha512, plus manifest.json that lists artifacts with checksums and a GPG signature file manifest.json.sig. This gives the security reviewer deterministic verification.
Maya Chen: Good. Action owners: Nora = create bucket prefix, lifecycle policy (auto-delete after 21 days) + logging; Ravi = SOC2 summary + pen-test exec summary + coordinate legal for raw report gating; Diego = upload instructions + presign process + sample script; Sasha = manifest + signature guidance and verify GPG key exchange. I'll coordinate with marketplace PM on the 72-hour reviewer SLA. @IntegrationBot open a ticket.
IntegrationBot: Created ticket INF-4488: "marketplace - SI/hw evidence intake (si-789)" assigned to Maya, Nora, Ravi, Diego, Sasha. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-4488 :robot_face:
Ravi Desai: On redaction - draft checklist: redact PII, collapse internal hostnames to <redacted-host>, remove database dumps, mask API keys and secrets, and remove orchestration tokens. I'll upload the draft to the ticket for security review.
Sasha Ivanov: Also add a requirement that binary firmware images must include provenance: build-id, build-date, and signing key fingerprint in the manifest. We'll require the partner to sign the manifest with an org key and provide the public key fingerprint.
Nora Park: Retention: we'll default to 21 days, can extend on a case-by-case request via the ticket. Logging retention for access logs will be 90 days.
Diego Alvarez: Small ops detail: we'll validate checksums server-side after upload and post a validation report file: validation-<timestamp>.txt in the same prefix. Partners must upload checksums and manifest first, then firmware binaries. We'll include an example validation report in the docs.
Maya Chen: Marketplace also asked about attestation format. Legal prefers a signed PDF but will accept an emailed attest with named exec + slack confirmation if signing not possible. Alex from legal will drop a short template into INF-4488.
Ravi Desai: I'll coordinate with Security to pre-approve a redaction sample set so legal review is quicker.
Sasha Ivanov: For verification: we should request partner GPG key via secure channel (Dedicated keystore or keybase) and publish our expected key fingerprint format in the ticket.
Maya Chen: Okay timeline: Nora to create prefix + presign flow by Wed morning, Ravi to post redaction checklist and SOC2 summary by Wed EOD, Sasha to post manifest/signing guidance by Thu morning, partners upload Thu morning-Thu evening window. Everyone update INF-4488 with progress. :white_check_mark:
